title: kehte hai sab peet kar sar alvida
body:
kehte hai sab peet kar sar alvida
aye naqi jaane payambar alvida
tumko maara zehr se pardes me
tha mutawakkil sitamgar alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
aapke marne se sab bedee'n hai shaad
shia hai ghamgee'n o muztar alvida
warise ilme nabi jaane ali
alvida aye dee'n ke rehbar alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
kargaye pardes me barbaad ghar
haaye jannat ke musafir alvida
